references.text: Describes the same procession with seven priests carrying seven ram's horns before the ark
Joshua's instructions to the priests about carrying the ark and blowing the horns
Repetition of the description of the priests blowing horns before the Lord's ark
The priests shall blow trumpets, a statute for all generations
The ark of the covenant is described, the same ark that was carried around Jericho
The Lord's ark of the covenant was carried by the priests when Israel crossed the Jordan
The Jubilee year and the use of ram's horns (shofar) blown on the Day of Atonement
Hebrews refers to how the walls of Jericho fell through faith after the people had marched around the city for seven days
